- Type 2 diabetes
  - Status: HbA1c 8.2%, fasting glucose 156 mg/dL, weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cutoff 90 cm)
  - Plan: Continue metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD; advise reduced carbohydrate intake, increase walking to 30 min daily; review in 3 months.
- Migraine
  - Status: 2 episodes/month, using sumatriptan SOS; propranolol 40 mg OD ongoing; topiramate not started.

- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with egg, limited sugar; Lunch – vegetable dal, brown rice portion controlled; Dinner – light soup, salad, avoid fried foods.
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.
